title: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India, (2017) 10 SCC 1
content.facts: The Constitution Bench considered privacy as a constitutional right in the digital and modern State.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether privacy is protected as a Fundamental Right.
content.ratioDecidendi: Privacy is intrinsic to dignity, liberty and Part III, subject to legality, legitimate aim, proportionality and procedural safeguards.
content.relevance: Use for surveillance, data protection and informational privacy.
